name: Run
instructions: Warm up with a brisk walk or easy jog.
Settle into a pace you can sustain.
Land with your foot under your hips.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.

safetyNotes: Increase distance gradually; stop for chest pain or dizziness.
